description: pm4ai monorepo — the fleet manager that syncs configs, generates CLAUDE.md, and runs maintenance across managed repos

scripts.build: bash -c "turbo build --output-logs=errors-only 2> >(grep -vE 'WARNING|Could not resolve workspaces|missing field|Turborepo will still function' >&2)"
scripts.pretest: which rg || sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep
scripts.test: bash -c "turbo test --output-logs=errors-only 2> >(grep -vE 'WARNING|Could not resolve workspaces|missing field|Turborepo will still function' >&2)"
